versions.author: designer
versions.summary:
Beavers and coots who all share one Health level: every Health gain fills a shared Pool split evenly across the tribe.
Go wide for many attackers or tall for high water that drowns smaller enemies; Attack stays each unit's own.

versions.author: reviser
versions.summary:
A Board unit's own Health is now its printed Health, closing the seated-Bird loop; the Peilmeester now drowns every Under unit, and the Pup and Hendrika state their order.
Winter Raft and Ledger Coot now read the water level, so the weakest generic cards join the tribe's law.

stop_reason: 2 of 3 reviewers said it's in a good spot
